description: Source code for the UrlContentFetcher class, which manages browser automation using Puppeteer to fetch web page content and convert it to Markdown, including handling Chromium setup and error retries.

classes.name: UrlContentFetcher
classes.description: A class that handles launching a headless browser, navigating to URLs, and converting page content to Markdown.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the UrlContentFetcher with a VSCode extension context.

methods.name: ensureChromiumExists
methods.description: Ensures Chromium is downloaded and available, downloading it if necessary.

methods.name: launchBrowser
methods.description: Launches a Puppeteer browser instance with specific arguments and sets up a new page.

methods.name: closeBrowser
methods.description: Closes the Puppeteer browser and resets internal references.

methods.name: urlToMarkdown
methods.description: Navigates to a URL, retries on certain errors, and converts the page content to Markdown.
